title: POV:

Countries started selling
their landmarks.
subs: In 2035, a country sold its most famous tower.
In twenty thirty-five, a country sold its most famous tower.
It was moved to a desert. Piece by piece.
Tourists still visit the old spot.
They take photos of where it used to be.
A famous clock tower was sold to a shopping mall.
It now runs fifteen minutes fast. So people shop faster.
A pyramid was bought by a gym.
It is now the world's largest stair machine.
A giant statue went to a car dealership.
It now holds a sign that says SALE.
Then a small island country sold itself.
It was towed to a new ocean.
Citizens woke up in a new time zone.
Nobody has told them what the country is called now.
The new owner is still deciding.
